description: This file defines the Order API controller for OpenCart, handling various order-related API endpoints such as creating, updating, and managing orders, including setting customer info, addresses, payment and shipping methods, and order confirmation.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Order API controller class for handling order-related API requests in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for the API, routing calls based on 'call' parameter and returning JSON response.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Loads customer controller to set customer info.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Loads payment address controller to set payment address.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Loads cart and shipping address controllers to set shipping address.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Loads necessary controllers to retrieve available shipping methods.

methods.name: setShippingMethod
methods.description: Sets shipping method after loading customer, cart, address controllers, and extensions.

methods.name: setPaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets payment method after loading necessary controllers and extensions.

methods.name: extension
methods.description: Handles extension-related API calls, loading extension controllers based on 'code' parameter.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Retrieves current cart info, including products, totals, and shipping requirement.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart and updates totals.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms and creates or updates an order, performing validation and saving order data.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history comment to an existing order.
